points.problem: Restore original graphics repaint before copied presentation
points.evidence: Original mouse_int2 explicitly flushes guest drawing made by application callback,including applications drawing their own graphics. cga.c also flushes when display is enabled. Current GRAPHICS branch signals capture of existing DIB and returns without calc_update or original readiness gates. Actual function control fails4/6 original-contract cases:ordinary graphics omits paint;uninitialized,disabled and mode-changing states still notify. Candidate that removes graphics-only branch and falls through original calc_update passes6/6. Original nt_vga/nt_ega painters call InvalidateConsoleDIBits,which marks graphics dirty;matched end_update releases existing publisher notification. Thus separate notification-only flush is redundant and not equivalent to original repaint. Text needs its existing completed-grid publication/rearm boundary.
points.minimum: Replace fullscreen split with existing text-only helper branch;let GRAPHICS execute original calc_update. Remove sole-use ntvdm_console_graphics_flush implementation/declaration;update graphics-publication fixture to exercise original painter invalidation rather than obsolete standalone flush. Preserve text helper and #error. Whole-file final build/runtime required.

points.problem: Respect frontend handoff and defer copied publication during mode settlement
points.evidence: nt_block_event_thread sets existing CNTRL_VDMBLOCKED before set_active(FALSE);resume reacquires before clearing bit. Without guard actual extracted tick fixture routes/paints/sends while blocked. Original NT4 local Console does not supply independent frontend ownership. Route synchronization translates existing frontend choice to software ScreenState and uses original refresh/cursor hooks. completed flag records whether execution reached an original timed repaint branch:forcing TRUE in actual function publishes/consumes pending frame on an ordinary mode-settle tick. Current passes both added mode-settle case and existing blocked/resume/error tests;each omission control fails at its specific assertion.
points.minimum: Retain existing blocked bit test,one software route call/error and one local completion flag pending owner. Remove explanatory comments at whole-file cleanup;retain excluded alternative framework. No new lifecycle or timer state.

points.problem: Carry original VGA font/palette across stream-to-native handoff
points.evidence: host_stream_io_update only WriteConsoleA bytes;nt_block_event_thread STREAM_IO arm only stream_io_update,not non-stream NtvdmConsoleUpdateText. NtvdmConsoleUpdateTextConfiguration copies original VGA fonts and palette without disabling stream mode. NTCON stores configuration separately;ntvwm_presentation_seed reads it and otherwise chooses fixed startup16-row font/mouse geometry. host_enable_stream_io does not reset guest VGA font state. Thus valid non-default VGA metadata in a stream source cannot be recovered from character Console calls alone;removing sole stream configuration producer leaves absent/stale metadata for native consumer. Existing tick fixture verifies stream configuration occurs on owned tick and not blocked tick. This is source data-flow proof and a bounded callback fixture,not fresh guest font-transition acceptance.
points.minimum: Keep configuration call and existing error propagation pending owner;remove two explanatory comment lines. Do not switch stream to video merely to obtain configuration.

No duplicate guest renderer or new polling is introduced.
